title: echemdb website
description:
Source code and curated content of the website echemdb.org, a community project for interfacial electrochemistry and local research data management following the FAIR principles. The website

  • displays the standardized and validated cyclic voltammograms of the echemdb electrochemistry-data repository, grouped by electrolyte, electrode material, and electrochemical system,
  • provides a curated collection of resources, i.e., open-source software tools, knowledge bases, and a reference table of best-practice literature for performing, reporting, and reproducing electrochemical measurements, and
  • introduces the tools of the echemdb ecosystem for creating, annotating, and evaluating electrochemical data.

A new version is archived whenever the website is updated. Changes between versions are listed in the ChangeLog.
